page_title: INT 1-1 LAZ | Inter v Lazio 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
87' 1 - 1 Denzel Dumfries (Inter) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 1:1.
87' It seemed like Alexis Sanchez (Inter) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
85' What a save from Ivan Provedel! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
82' Tajon Buchanan (Inter) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
81' Inter can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
79' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) takes just a short run up and his weak free kick from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
78' That's the end of the game for Mario Gila, who is replaced by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio).
78' Inter are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
77' Substitution. Federico Dimarco is replaced by Tajon Buchanan (Inter).
77' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Hakan Calhanoglu and he is replaced by Alexis Sanchez (Inter).
76' The ball is cleared after Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
74' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Luis Alberto (Lazio) coming on for Mattia Zaccagni.
72' Igor Tudor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Felipe Anderson (Lazio) replacing Daichi Kamada.
71' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
70' Daichi Kamada (Lazio) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
66' It will be a substitution. Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is ready to enter the pitch as Nicolo Rovella walks off.
66' Igor Tudor prepares a substitution. Luca Pellegrini is replaced by Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
65' Carlos Augusto (Inter) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
64' Substitution. Henrikh Mkhitaryan leaves the pitch and is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
64' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Alessandro Bastoni will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
64' Substitution. Matteo Darmian walks off the pitch and Denzel Dumfries (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
62' A great run from Matias Vecino (Lazio) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
59' CHANCE! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the right post!
59' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will take the corner.

58' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and attempts to place his header inside the left post. Ivan Provedel shows his fast reflexes, though, and makes a nice save.
55' Inter players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
52' Nicolo Casale (Lazio) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
51' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' What a great effort! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches over the crossbar. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal.
47' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Juan Luca Sacchi starts the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
45+1' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Nicolo Barella (Inter) inside the box.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
41' The referee signals a free kick. Inter are going to take it from long range.
39' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
35' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
32' 0 - 1 Daichi Kamada (Lazio) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!

30' Adam Marusic (Lazio) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
28' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Federico Dimarco (Inter) strikes the ball towards the top right corner of the goal and raises his hands to celebrate, but the goalkeeper somehow manages to deny his attempt.
28' Inter work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
27' Federico Dimarco (Inter) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Ivan Provedel makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
23' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:2.
20' Lazio are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
18' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) and Hakan Calhanoglu matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.

14' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
13' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle and it's Federico Dimarco (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
9' A quickly taken corner by Inter.
7' The resulting corner from Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
6' The Lazio players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
6' The Lazio players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.

4' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Yann Sommer is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:1.
3' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

3' He should have scored! Marcus Thuram (Inter) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Ivan Provedel makes an easy save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Inter will have the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
